subject: Security discovery recap — audit logs, retention path & DPA next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Liu Chen <lchen@aurumbank.com>; Security Team <security@aurumbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + asks from today’s discovery call

Hi Liu / Aurum team —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of the items we discussed and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Key pain points you called out:
- Audit log granularity & retention: you need immutable audit logs for API activity and admin actions retained for 7 years, with tamper-evident timestamps.
- SOC 2 and pen test evidence: requirement to see SOC 2 Type II (most recent period) and a pen test report within the last 12 months or a remediation plan if vendor restrictions apply.
- DPA & data residency: DPA must explicitly allow EU/US residency options and retention/erasure clauses consistent with your legal team.
- Access controls & RBAC: clear service account mapping and role separation for SRE vs app users.

Our goals / what we propose:
1) Share a short evidence matrix mapping Redwood artifacts to your asks (attached: "Aurum-evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx").
2) Provide our SOC 2 controls summary and a redacted Type II report (attached: "SOC2-controls-summary.pdf").
3) Share a DPA draft and open a procurement thread (attached: "DPA-draft-Aurum-Redwood_v1.docx").
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive with our product security + your SREs next week to walk audit log formats, retention APIs, and KV encryption details.

Asks for Aurum: 
- Can you confirm the procurement contact and whether a DoD-style evidence package is required for internal auditors? (procurement POC / timeline)
- Prioritize the artifacts you want in the matrix (e.g., logs, pen test report, encryption key material, SOC 2). If you can highlight must-haves vs nice-to-haves by EOD Thu that helps us accelerate.
- Any constraints for sharing redacted pen test results (vendor embargo / NDA)?

Next steps (from Redwood):
- We’ll share the evidence matrix and SOC 2 summary today.
- Proposed technical deep-dive slots: Tue 5/20 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 5/21 14:00–15:00 PT. Please confirm which works.

Attachments: Aurum-evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx, SOC2-controls-summary.pdf, DPA-draft-Aurum-Redwood_v1.docx

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
----
From: Liu Chen <lchen@aurumbank.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Security Team <security@aurumbank.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@aurumbank.com>
Date: 2025-05-19T09:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today’s discovery call

Logan — thanks for the concise summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: 7 years is correct for logs that relate to financial transactions and admin changes. For lower-sensitivity telemetry we can accept a 1-year window.
2) SOC 2: we require a redacted Type II covering the last 12 months. If Redwood only has a Type I or a soon-to-be-completed audit, we need a compensating control plan.
3) Pen test: we can accept a redacted report or an attestation from a recognized 3P vendor (e.g., NCC Group, Bishop Fox). If Redwood has a remediation timeline that’s acceptable, we can move forward subject to procurement approval.
4) DPA: Procurement will need the clause mapping for data residency + subprocessor list. We expect to start negotiations the week of 5/26.

Procurement POC: Dana Ortiz (procure@aurumbank.com). She will send a standard vendor intake form and timeline. Security POC for technical deep-dive: Max Rivera (max.rivera@aurumbank.com).

We’ll prioritize the following artifacts as MUST-HAVE in the evidence matrix: SOC 2 Type II (redacted), pen-test within 12 months (redacted ok), audit log export format & retention APIs, encryption & key escrow documentation. Everything else is nice-to-have.

On deep-dive timing: Wed 5/21 14:00–15:00 PT works for Max and myself. 

—Liu
Director, Security & Compliance
Aurum Bank

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Liu Chen <lchen@aurumbank.com>, Max Rivera <max.rivera@aurumbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Dana Ortiz <procure@aurumbank.com>
Date: 2025-05-19T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today’s discovery call

Appreciate the prioritization, Liu — that helps. Confirming items we’ll deliver today / Monday morning: 
- Updated evidence matrix with MUST-HAVE flags (see attached).
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (or our latest Type II + a controls map).
- Redacted pen-test report (latest) or vendor attestation + remediation ETA.
- API contract doc for audit log exports (JSON schema + retention endpoints).

We’ll lock the deep-dive for Wed 5/21 14:00–15:00 PT and send a calendar invite to Max, Liu, Dana, and the Redwood security engineers.

For procurement / DPA: Rachel is looping in to start the contract thread and share the DPA draft/clauses.

If there are any additional legal constraints (e.g., embargoed artifacts), please highlight before the call so we can prepare redactions.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.
Logan
----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: pre-call checklist for Aurum deep-dive

Internal note — prepping security + product folks for Wed: 
- Owners: Neha (evidence matrix owner), Rachel (commercial/DPA), Sagar P. (product security lead) will join the call.
- Action items before Wed: consolidate redactions on pen-test, export sample logs (3 examples: admin create-user, model inference request, token billing event), and prepare a short slide on retention configuration (how to set 7y for audit events).
- Risk flags: subprocessor list needs review — add legal check for any non-US subprocessors.

Logan — I’ll push the compiled materials to the Drive folder and drop a link in the calendar invite.

-Neha
Senior Solutions Security
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Ortiz <procure@aurumbank.com>; Liu Chen <lchen@aurumbank.com>; Max Rivera <max.rivera@aurumbank.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-21T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: DPA + procurement intake & next steps (Aurum)

Hi Dana / team —

Thanks again for coordinating. I’ve attached an editable DPA draft (DPA-draft-Aurum-Redwood_v1.docx) to this thread and opened the vendor intake link for your procurement form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AEXAMPLE/evidence-matrix. 

Next steps for procurement: 
- Dana: please share your intake form and expected procurement timeline; if you have a standard redline list, send that by 5/28 so we can route to legal.
- Security: we will share redacted SOC 2 and pen-test artifacts in Drive before the Wed deep-dive.
- Commercial: Logan and I will follow-up with pricing/options for Dedicated capacity if you want an isolated pool for regulated traffic.

DocuSign link (for reference / later): https://app.docusign.com/templates/EX-12345

If you prefer, we can fast-track a data-processor addendum in parallel with procurement — let me know and I’ll prioritize.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: DPA-draft-Aurum-Redwood_v1.docx, Aurum-evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx, SOC2-controls-summary.pdf
